entry.title: Stevequencer 1.1.1
entry.summary: 16 steps on a 4x4 grid, up to four pages (64 steps), edited from the Q-Links. ## What's new in 1.1.1 **Count-in, fixed for a plain Play.** When MPC counts in on every Play (Metro → Count-In: Record + Play), 1.1.0 still started part-way through the count-in: MPC moves its position back once during the count-in as well as at the real start. Now the sequencer waits for MPC's real start, a bar after Play, in any time signature. Checked on a Live II. **COUNT-IN is three buttons** on SETUP, OFF | REC

entry.title: Stevequencer 1.1.0
entry.summary: 16 steps on a 4x4 grid, up to four pages (64 steps), edited from the Q-Links. ## What's new in 1.1.0 **COUNT-IN** on the SETUP page. During MPC's count-in, MPC tells plugins it is already playing, so the sequencer used to play the count-in bar. Set COUNT-IN like MPC's Metro → Count-In: RECORD if MPC counts in only when you record, REC+PLAY if it counts in on every Play. The sequencer then sends nothing until MPC's real start and begins there. If no count-in comes, it starts after nine beats anyw

entry.title: Stevequencer 1.0.0
entry.summary: 16 steps on a 4x4 grid, up to four pages (64 steps), edited from the Q-Links. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.
